def find_max_bucket(buckets):
    for i in range(len(buckets) - 1, -1, -1):
        if buckets[i] > 0:
            return i
    return -1

def main():
    length = int(input())
    limit_b = int(input())
    sequence_arr = [int(input()) for _ in range(length)]
    
    bucket_array = [0] * 101
    total_sum_b = 0
    
    even_counter = 0
    odd_counter = 0
    segment_start_idx = 0
    total_segments_count = 0
    current_index = 1
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(sequence_arr) - 1:
        if sequence_arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even_counter += 1
        else:
            odd_counter += 1

        if even_counter == odd_counter:
            diff_value = abs(sequence_arr[i + 1] - sequence_arr[i])
            max_bucket_val = find_max_bucket(bucket_array)
            if total_sum_b > limit_b and diff_value < max_bucket_val:
                total_sum_b -= max_bucket_val
                bucket_array[max_bucket_val] -= 1
                bucket_array[diff_value] += 1
                total_sum_b += diff_value
            elif total_sum_b < limit_b:
                total_sum_b += diff_value
                bucket_array[diff_value] += 1
                total_segments_count += 1
                segment_start_idx = i + 1
            if i == len(sequence_arr) - 2 and current_index < len(sequence_arr) - 1:
                i = segment_start_idx
                segment_start_idx += 1
                even_counter = 0
                odd_counter = 0
                continue
        i += 1

    i = len(bucket_array) - 1
    while total_sum_b > limit_b:
        if bucket_array[i] > 0:
            total_sum_b -= i
            total_segments_count -= 1
        else:
            i -= 1

    print(total_segments_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
